title: Кібератаки групи UAC-0010 (Armageddon): шкідливі програми GammaLoad, GammaSteel (CERT-UA#5134)

entities.name: UAC-0010 (Armageddon)
entities.gloss: A Russian cyber espionage group targeting Ukrainian organizations and government bodies.

entities.name: GammaLoad.PS1
entities.gloss: A PowerShell-based dropper and downloader script used to fetch subsequent malicious payloads.

entities.name: GammaSteel.PS1
entities.gloss: A PowerShell-based malware tool designed to steal files matching specific extensions.

entities.name: GammaSteel.NET
entities.gloss: A .NET-based malware tool designed to harvest authentication credentials from web browsers.

entities.name: HarvesterX
entities.gloss: An information-stealing tool historically utilized by threat actors to exfiltrate sensitive data.

entities.name: PowerShell
entities.gloss: A task automation and configuration management framework developed by Microsoft.

entities.name: wscript.exe
entities.gloss: A legitimate Windows executable used to execute VBScript and JScript scripts.

entities.name: mshta.exe
entities.gloss: A legitimate Windows utility used to execute Microsoft HTML Application (HTA) files.

relations.head: UAC-0010 (Armageddon)
relations.evidence: ланцюг доставки GammaLoad.PS1 на комп'ютер жертви
